The '''Vriisan irstat''' was a [[Tarasin]] tribe.

==History==
The Vriisan irstat lived in the jungles of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. When the explorer [[Reidi Artom]] discovered Cularin, she left a number of writings inside a cave, which the Vriisan became custodians of.<ref name="RAEM">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040115manifesto|text=Reidi Artom's Expansion Manifesto}}</ref>

About 30 years before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Niroida]] was the [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] of the irstat and she was succeeded by [[Kasslan]].<ref name="RAEM" />
